name: Swampletics: Morytania Locked UIM
overview: Swampletics is an Old School RuneScape series created by Settled. The series follows an Ultimate Ironman character who is permanently locked inside Morytania, a dangerous swamp region, with the ultimate goal of completing the Theater of Blood, using only local resources.

trailers.title: I locked my fresh Ultimate Ironman in Morytania (Swampletics #1)
